source_selection.exact_source_expression: It's everything. Paul says, "Remove that one thing and forget all the heavy theology we talk about. It gives meaning to the deity, the death, the resurrection, what we call the gospel message, all of pastoral theology, all of practice." (S004-S006)
source_selection.reason: The claim has a clear logical structure: a dependency relation between the resurrection and every other Christian doctrine/practice. This can be modeled as a propositional dependency graph over a finite set of doctrines, with the resurrection as a distinguished node whose removal collapses the truth of all others. The formalization is a structural/logical model, not a historical or theological proof.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: A doctrine-dependency structure is a finite type D of doctrines, a distinguished element resurrection : D, and a relation depends : D → D → Prop such that for every d : D with d ≠ resurrection, depends d resurrection holds. The structure is 'resurrection-central' if for every d : D, d ≠ resurrection → depends d resurrection.

assumptions_and_dependencies.non_vacuity_requirement: D must contain at least two distinct elements, one of which is resurrection, so that the centrality condition is not vacuously true.

result_and_boundary.what_is_established: A formal dependency structure in which the resurrection is a distinguished node on which every other doctrine depends. This captures the logical shape of the claim, not its truth.
result_and_boundary.what_remains_open: Whether the dependency relation is well-founded, whether it is acyclic, and whether the theological premise that the resurrection occurred is true. The Lean model does not establish any historical or theological fact.

source_selection.exact_source_expression: He calls us to be as radically committed to him as he was to us. ... We're saved by grace, not by these works, but we do them out of gratitude and commitment. (S010-S011, S092-S098)
source_selection.reason: The claim distinguishes salvation by grace from works of radical commitment. This can be modeled as a two-layer structure: a salvation predicate that holds independently of works, and a commitment predicate that is motivated by gratitude. The formalization captures the logical distinction, not the theological truth.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: A grace-commitment structure is a type Agent, a predicate Saved : Agent → Prop, a predicate Committed : Agent → Prop, and a relation Motivates : Agent → Agent → Prop, such that for every a : Agent, Saved a is independent of Committed a, and Committed a is motivated by gratitude for salvation.

source_selection.exact_source_expression: When we suffer or face persecution, the resurrection gives us hope and strength. Because Jesus rose, we know death is not the end, and we have eternal life, so we can face anything. (S207-S228)
source_selection.reason: The claim has a conditional structure: if the resurrection is true, then suffering and persecution are not ultimate defeats. This can be modeled as a modal or conditional logic over states of affairs, where the resurrection entails a property of 'hope' that neutralizes the force of suffering.

source_selection.exact_source_expression: Most doubt is emotional, not factual. To overcome it, we must fill our minds with the truth of the resurrection, which counteracts the lies and fears we tell ourselves. (S239-S256)
source_selection.reason: The claim has a cognitive-therapeutic structure: emotional doubt is caused by false beliefs, and replacing them with true beliefs (specifically the resurrection) reduces doubt. This can be modeled as a belief-revision process over a set of propositions.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: A belief-revision structure is a type Agent, a type Proposition, a belief function B : Agent → Proposition → Prop, a doubt predicate D : Agent → Prop, and a truth predicate T : Proposition → Prop, such that for every a : Agent, if D a holds, then there exists a false belief p with B a p and ¬ T p, and replacing p with a true belief q (T q) reduces D a.
